highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 brings Skia m159 and requires .NET 9 or later for WebAssembly native assets.
highlights_body: The engine update includes WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements and image/rendering corrections. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

breaking.title: Move WebAssembly consumers off .NET 8
breaking.body: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 9 or later; unsupported WASM frameworks are rejected before building. Upgrade .NET 8 browser applications and use runtime-matched archives: .NET 9/10 use Emscripten 3.1.56, while .NET 11+ use 6.0.2. These archives are not interchangeable with older toolchains. Non-WASM .NET 8 support is unchanged.

bullets.detail: Updates the native renderer with WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements and image/rendering correctness fixes. C API exports and public managed signatures are unchanged.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 9 or later and retain runtime-matched archives for supported toolchains. Non-WASM .NET 8 support is unchanged.
